title: Mail boat lunch
caption: Lobster rolls on the mail boat
description: Two family members share lobster rolls on the deck of a small boat on a bright summer afternoon. Water and a rocky shoreline are behind them, and everyone looks relaxed and sun-warmed.
searchSummary: Lunch of lobster rolls on the mail boat in the harbour: seafood, boat trip, summer holiday, sea, Maine coast, family meal, sunny deck.
